text: Saltat H is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a blue saltat variant with a white belly. It can be obtained from Bressole, the Fugitive in Oblivia.
Scirpo A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a black and green scirpo variant with a red acid sac. It can be obtained from silver drops from Yelena, the Sequestered in Primordia.

Scirpo B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a black and blue scirpo variant with a blue-green acid sac. It can be obtained from silver drops from Desdemona, the Subterranean in Noctilum.
Scirpo C is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a white and purple scirpo variant with a pink acid sac. It can be obtained from silver drops from Elena, the Infernal in Noctilum.
Scintimure A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a red scintimure variant. It can be obtained from Eddy, the Electric Heat in Cauldros.
Scintimure B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a black scintimure variant. It can be obtained from Zohan, the Thunderbolt in Sylvalum.
Scintimure C is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a white scintimure variant. It can be obtained from Legato, the Sky Watcher in Sylvalum.
Scintimure D is a Holofigure in . It depicts a purple scintimure variant. It can be obtained from Coil, the Never-Ending in Cauldros.

Sakuraba Basic (Male) is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a male mannequin wearing a complete set of Sakuraba Industries BLADE Wear. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission A Hero's Ride. It is obtained by completing the Wreckage category of the Primordia Collectopedia. It is obtained by completing the Relics category of the Noctilum Collectopedia. It is obtained by completing the Flora category of the Collectopedia. It is obtained by completing the Curios category of the Oblivia Collectopedia. Scary Shrooms is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.2, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting sixteen Xiphias. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Securing Safety is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.8, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting ten Oc-servs. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Secret Activities is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.19, and is unlocked if the Squad defeats the Gularth during The Sucking Filiavent. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Scouting Antropolis is a Support Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked when Chapter 12 is completed, and allows a large amount of Credits and Miranium to be earned quickly. Enemies do not drop any items in this mission. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Sandstorm Screen is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that nullifies the debuffs from sandstorm weather. The Skell equivalent is Weather.S-STORM-RES.

The Second Barrier Key is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. During Definian Downfall it must be obtained along with the First and Third Barrier Keys to lower a forcefield. It can be found in Cauldros's Ganglion Antropolis, on a raised area to the left of the entrance after leaving the tunnel.
Secondary CD Reducer is a ground weapon art mod augment in and . It reduces secondary cooldown by 1% to 20%.

The Scrap Duo is a unique melee weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a level 1 Common-quality Dual Swords obtained during the course of the Affinity Mission The Little Rich Girl. It must be used to defeat the Disaster Vigent. It cannot be sold or discarded, even after the mission is completed. L's Shop cannot be used to add more Augment slots.
Schematics are items in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are template file items for armor or weapons to craft at the AM Terminal.

The Savage Ziyse is a one-of-a-kind ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Gatling Gun. It is acquired during the Normal Mission Ovah and Out and must be used to defeat the Bio Visigels. It must be returned to Han'barac at the end of the mission. This weapon cannot be sold, nor can any augment slots be added to it.
Scouters are Casual Wear Head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries.
The Sampling Bottle is an Important Item in . It is obtained from Keith at the Water Purification Plant in Primordia during the course of Water Woes.

The Scienti Glyph is a rare glyph item in . As a glyph, it is available from Unique Monsters between levels 30-39. Unusually, it can also be obtained from the Baby Armu on Agora Shore by using Yoink!. According to their description, the truth of knowledge is inscribed on them and like every glyph, they sell for a high price on the market.

Scratched Jewels are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by Perna Eluca at Eryth Sea, and can be traded for in Alcamoth and at Eryth Sea with four NPCs. According to their description, their surface is scratched and polishing it should raise their value. Five of them are needed for Betrothal Test (Zel Argentis).

The Salvage Deck (Japanese: , Sarubējidekki) is a location in . It is located in Goldmouth at the Argentum Trade Guild. This location's main use is salvaging, with a salvage point located on the right-most dock.
Scorpion Tail (Japanese: , Sukōpionteiru) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Chroma Katana.
Scattershot (Japanese: , Barabara misairu) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Tora's arts when using Mech Arms. It grants Evasion.

The Sanguinous Grotto (Japanese: , Chinure no Dōkutsu) is a location in . It is located northeast of Tamie Pillars and north-northeast of Heimos's Crevasse on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal; a trail of blood spatters from slain Aries leads directly to the entrance.
Salvaging Made Easy are Literature items in . They can be purchased at the Reedirait Bookstore run by Pelala in the Argentum Trade Guild. They are one of T-elos's favorite Pouch items.
The Savvy Deeds are Store Deeds in . They can be purchased from Café Savvy in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
Sand Salmon Ceviches are Seafood Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Hanoon Fishmongers in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
The Salter Deeds are deeds Key Items in . They can be purchased from Salter Sweets in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Secret Trials are Board Game Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Elgeschel Hobby Store in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Scarlet Shamisens are Instrument Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Vibrattio Instruments in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Perceval.
Sanar-Knit Headbands are Textile Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Fallone Crafts in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Sanar-Knit Blankets are Textile Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Fallone Crafts in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Salter Sweets is a shop in . It is run by Scenna and is located in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. It is specialized in Desserts.
Scenna is an NPC in . Scenna is an Ardainian who can be found in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. Scenna runs a shop called Salter Sweets specialized in Desserts.
Saramena is an NPC in . Saramena is a Tantalese who can be found in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. Saramena runs a shop called Platini Deli specialized in Staple Foods.

Sandl Rapchors (Japanese: , Sanba Raputa) are enemies in . They are members of the Rapchor family and can be found at level 30 - 40 on the Upper Level - Right of the Gormott Province, particularly on the east bank of Coolley Lake and outside the Brigands' Hideout.

Sandl Runners (Japanese: , Chiaru Rannā) are enemies in . They are members of the Rapchor family and can be found at level 31 - 36 on the Upper Level - Right level of the Gormott Province, particularly on the east bank of Coolley Lake.

Sauros's Bed (Japanese: , Saurā no Nedoko) is a Location in . It is located on the right side of the upper level of the Gormott Province, just to the west of the Traveler's Resting Tree and south of Spraywater Caverns. It is a hollow hidden behind trees containing a single Treasure Trove with a rare Core Crystal and gold, and is named for the lone Ancient Sauros that roams in front of it. There are no enemies in the bed itself.

Samoo Volffs (Japanese: , Zamūru Vorufu) are enemies in . They are members of the Volff family and can be found at level 37-41 around Fable Rock in the Kingdom of Tantal. Six of them must be defeated to unlock Pandoria's level 2 Thunder Doom.

Sarabashi Ropl (Japanese: , Sarubātsu Ryibura) are enemies in . They are members of the Ropl family and can be found at level 80-82 in the Chansagh Wastes of the Empire of Mor Ardain. Two of them must be defeated to unlock Corvin's level 5 Alae Custodiae Battle Skill.
Seared Whitebaits are Seafood Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Coral Leaf Fresh Fish in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.
Sautéed Beat Shrimps are Seafood Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Coral Leaf Fresh Fish in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.
Scura Antols (Japanese: , Sukyura Antoru) are enemies in . They are members of the Antol family, and can be found at level 43-45 at the Malignant Gorge on the Central Plain of Temperantia.

Salty Soils are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya, in particular at Olethro Playhouse and Soulcrown Summit. Five are needed for the quest Tranquility. One is needed to refine Fast Blade Switch VI.

Sand Salmons are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in the Empire of Mor Ardain through Salvaging, or at the southern Collection Point in the Fief of Forgetfulness and the western Collection Point at the Nopon Pioneers' Spring. One can be used to prepare a ration needed for the quest The Supply Situation. Ten are needed to unlock Corvin's level 3 "Ancient Wisdom".
Scent Stones are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Scimitar Grasses are Flower collectibles in . They can be found in Temperantia.

Secret Turfs are Flower collectibles in . They can be found in Temperantia, in particular southwest of the Ardainian Garrison. One is needed for each Ultimate Shield Aux Core the party wishes to refine.
Search Monitors are Treasure items in . They can be obtained through Salvaging at Port Anangham in the Empire of Mor Ardain. One is needed during Newt Recruits.

Salvaging is an activity and game mechanic in . As a salvager, Rex is able to dive beneath the Cloud Sea to recover lost treasures. He will encounter several salvager NPCs through the game who wear a diver suit. Salvaging can be a significant source of Gold, as well as Mechanical and Fish collectibles and Treasure items. Some Key Items needed to complete Quests must be obtained through salvaging. Enemies can appear as a result of salvaging. Rex can only salvage at designated places, called Salvage Points, localized with a blue "hook" icon across Alrest. Most areas have at least one Salvage Point.

Scorpoxes (Japanese: , Sukopio) are a family of enemies in the , first appearing in . They are scorpion-like creatures very similar to Crustips, and are mostly yellow, although one gray variety can be found in Spirit Crucible Elpys.

Sammel Squoods (Japanese: , Sumageru Suīdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Squood family, and can be found at level 88-90 at the Genbu Drifts on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, during foggy weather.

Scale Chips are Core Chips in and . They can be bought from Lleman Blacksmiths, and dropped by various low level enemies in Gormott Province and the Kingdom of Uraya. Scale Chips share their appearance with Fang Chips, Horn Chips, and Wing Chips. __TOC__
Sandi Bunnits (Japanese: , Sando Banitto) are enemies in . They are members of the Bunnit family, and can be found at level 25-27 at the Old Industrial District in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Sandstream (Japanese: , Sandosutorēmu) is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian Driver. He taunts Godfrey for his sense of justice, and later takes advantage of the dancer Harghal to cause chaos in Theosoir.
Saisai is a Nopon in . He can be found at the Ayvill Shopping District in the Empire of Mor Ardain during Fool's Gold.
Salman is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found at Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild. Later, he can be found at Port Anangham in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

The Sealed Core Crystal is a special Core Crystal in . It allows Herald to be awakened. It can be obtained as a reward at the Theospiti Temple Ruins in Theosoir by offering a total of 100 of the following items at the Altar of Sealing, found behind a cracked wall of the Theospiti Temple Ruins. * Poison Flash * Black Pomegranate * Acid Tomato * Lazy Crayfish * Beelze Mosquito * Blood Walnut * Sore Worm * Pound Viper * Dark Sprout
Salvage King is a quest in . It can be received from Eulogimenos at the Royal Audience Hall in the Kingdom of Tantal.

Sappan Veg Juices are Drink Pouch items in . They can be purchased from 12 Brothersisterpon in the Argentum Trade Guild, once all other Brothersisterpon in Alrest have been found and returned to Argentum.
Salvaging Wisdom 1 is an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop in the Argentum Trade Guild.
Salvaging Wisdom 2 is an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop in the Argentum Trade Guild.

The Salvager Rank A Cert. is a Key Item in . It is received from Mochichi in the Goldmouth Res. Dist. in the Argentum Trade Guild, when he evaluates Rex to have risen to Salvager Rank A, or "Divine Salvager".

The Salvager Rank B Cert. is a Key Item in . It is received from Mochichi in the Goldmouth Res. Dist. in the Argentum Trade Guild, when he evaluates Rex to have risen to Salvager Rank B, or "Legendary Salvager".

The Salvager Rank C Cert. is a Key Item in . It is received from Mochichi in the Goldmouth Res. Dist. in the Argentum Trade Guild, when he evaluates Rex to have risen to Salvager Rank C, or "Mushroom-Feast Salvager".

The Salvager Rank D Cert. is a Key Item in . It is received from Mochichi in the Goldmouth Res. Dist. at the Argentum Trade Guild, when he evaluates Rex to have risen to Salvager Rank D, or "Bana-Level Salvager".

The Salvager Rank E Cert. is a Key Item in . It is received from Mochichi in the Goldmouth Res. Dist. at the Argentum Trade Guild, when he evaluates Rex to be Salvager Rank E, or "Baby-Level Salvager".

The Security Tirkin (Japanese: , Sekyuriti Tākin) is a Story Exclusive Enemy in . It is a member of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 33 in the Work Observation Tower of the Old Factory in the Empire of Mor Ardain during Chapter 4. It drops the Hangar Division Key when defeated.
Schott is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian doctor who lives in Alba Cavanich, the capital of the Empire of Mor Ardain. He is spoken to during the quest "A Secret Cure".

The Seed-Grill Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Secret Route. It enables the purchase of Whitebait With Seeds from the Ikthus Fishmongers shop at Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.

The Samod Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Frozen Door. It enables the purchase of Poached Fruit Samod from the Platini Deli shop at Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.

Screw Reaper (Japanese: , Sukuryūrīpā) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using a Calamity Scythe. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Rex's Axe Twist.
Sand Break is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Cobra Bardiche. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0).

Sandrin is an NPC in . He is an Indoline who can be initially found at Goetuis Port in the Indoline Praetorium, but later moves to the Argentum Trade Guild's Central Exchange. He runs a shop called Topsten Trading.

Screw Cutter (Japanese: , Sukuryūkattā) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using Infinity Fans. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Rex's Strong Saucer.

Seafood Chowder are Key Items in . They can be made by the Famed Gourmet Chefs in the Bellyfull Canteen in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the DLC Quest Midnight Feasting upon installing the New Quests Pack 1 of the Expansion Pass.
Scarecrow is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using Infinity Fans. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0).

Seals are status effects and a battle mechanic in . They consist of several sealing effects that prevent an enemy from inflicting certain debuffs or performing some other actions that could be detrimental to the party. They are inflicted upon completing a full three stage Blade Combo. Which seal is inflicted depends on the element of the combo's finisher. When a Blade Combo is active during combat, any seals that can be inflicted with it are listed at the end of the respective route of the combo chart located in the top right corner of the screen.
Sealing Effects is an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop at the Kedeigh Gate of Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

The Salvager's Diary is a Key Item in . It can be obtained from a Treasure Trove in Litharia Snowfield in the Kingdom of Tantal during the quest Glory from the Past, during which it must be delivered to Ekurt.

Salvage Point Enemies are enemies in that appear as a result of salvaging at various Salvage Points throughout Alrest. Unlike normal enemies, they will attack regardless of level difference. Furthermore, if the party flees and gets far enough away, they will vanish without returning to their starting point.

Salvager Rank is an informal quest in . This is not a formal quest so it does not appear in the Quest Log. It can be initiated by speaking to Mochichi on a balcony in Argentum's Goldmouth Res. Dist. and asking him about Salvager Rank. After this, he can be spoken to anytime and paid a fee to judge Rex's Salvager Rank. If Rex has earned enough Salvaging points to increase his rank, Mochichi will give him a Salvager Rank certificate and various other rewards.

The Sakryfyce Igna (Japanese: , Sakurifaisu Igūna) is a quest-exclusive boss in . It is a member of the Igna family, and can be found at level 60 in the Desta Plains in Temperantia during the DLC Quest A Mercenary's Honor, alongside the Vyktym Igna and Blood-Crazed Stalker.

Savage Dromarch (Japanese: ) is a DLC Aux Core in . It decreases the Aggro generated by Arts and Specials by 15%. It also changes Dromarch's appearance when he equips the core, granting him a orange color scheme. It can be purchased at the DLC shop Noponstone Exchange for 35 Noponstones in the Land of Challenge obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. The Obsidian Dromarch DLC Aux Core has an equivalent effect, which is functionally identical to the Arts Stealth V Aux Core.

Saranga Ignas (Japanese: , Sarunga Igūna) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Igna family that are fought at level 100 during the first wave of the Challenge Battle Humanoid Alliance. This enemy drops no items.

Scheele Scorpoxes (Japanese: , Suchīru Sukopio) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Scorpox family, and can be found at level 60 during Call the Exterminators, a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This enemy drops no items.

Scalpe Plambuses (Japanese: , Sukarabe Mosūn) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Plambus family, and can be found at level 56 during Call the Exterminators, a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This enemy drops no items.

Search for Tekuteku is a DLC Quest in . It can be received from Amir at the Geothermal Plant Lobby in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the DLC Quest Hot Spring Bonanza, part of the New Quests Pack 4 of the Expansion Pass.

Search for Alec is a DLC Quest in . It can be received from Amir at the Geothermal Plant Lobby in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the DLC Quest Hot Spring Bonanza, part of the New Quests Pack 4 of the Expansion Pass.

Sarrac is an Ardainian in . He is the father of Lee Soon, and can be found at the Pipe Maintenance Office in Mor Ardain during the DLC quest Search for Sarrac, part of the DLC Quest Hot Spring Bonanza.

Search for Sarrac is a DLC Quest in . It can be received from Amir at the Geothermal Plant Lobby in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the DLC Quest Hot Spring Bonanza, part of the New Quests Pack 4 of the Expansion Pass.

Scarlet Inquisitor Mòrag (Japanese: , Shinku Reisō no Merefu) is a DLC Accessory in that increases the wearer's dexterity stat. It is unlocked after the Nopon Invitation is collected from the Helpful New Features released as part of the version 1.5.1 update. It grants the same bonus as Legendary rarity Carbon Gloves. Scarlet Inquisitor Mòrag cannot be worn with Rainbow Gloves, Carbon Gloves, Hero Gloves, Vivid Mitts, Dress Uniform Mòrag, or another Scarlet Inquisitor Mòrag. When equipped by Mòrag it changes her outward appearance to a red version of her outfit.

The Scram Igna (Japanese: , Sukyamu Igūna) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Igna family, and can be found at level 60 in the Isle of Urchon of the Leftherian Archipelago during the DLC quest Bright Spark, alongside the Larm and Larm Ignas. It is then fought at the Lud Cloudway: Fonsett alongside the Riot, Trauv and Gigalid Ignas. This enemy drops no items.
Salvage the Salvager is a quest in . It can be received from Dudan at the Lascham Cove on Gormott.
Scarlet Coils are Mechanical collectibles in . They can be obtained from Old Machine Collection Points in Gormott, including one on the shoreline south of the Coolley Lake Camp.

The Secluded Boneway (Japanese: , Kazenuke Honemichi) is a landmark in . It is a tunnel located on the southwest side of the central area of the Lasaria Region, between the Haradd Hills and the Cropwoods of Yorn. The Dawning Slate Piece can be found here.

The Saints' Practice Grounds (Japanese: , Seija no Shūrenjō) are a location in . They are located along the western edge of the northern area of Gormott, and can be accessed by climbing the sloping root near Valafum Hill and going north. There are two Treasure Troves, several Collection Points and an ether miasma here.

Salsh Rhoguls (Japanese: , Surasshu Rōguru) are enemies in . They are members of the Rhogul family and can be found at level 5-10 in the Lasaria Region of the Kingdom of Torna, particularly around the Haradd Hills and in the Secluded Boneway.

Sarchess Gradies (Japanese: , Sāshesu Guradi) are enemies in . They are members of the Grady family and can be found at level 10 - 11 in the Lasaria Region of the Kingdom of Torna, particularly at Mernes Falls.

Scowling Quincey (Japanese: , Nirami no Kīruson) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Tirkin family and can be found at level 25 in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna, on the lowest level of the Tirkin Cliff Colony. It is accompanied by two Arrah Rhoguls.
Sand Upas are Insect collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna.
Samomo is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found on the Maelstrom in the Argentum Trade Guild. Samomo only appears during the quest Fool's Gold.

Scribo Quadwings (Japanese: , Sukurība Kurōdo) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Quadwing family, and can be found at level 40-42 at the Hoary Weald in Gormott. Two need to be defeated to unlock Minoth's level 5 Ciclón.

Sarah is an NPC in . She is a Tornan who can be found near the Spefan Inn in the Kingdom of Torna. She is the object of Leo's affection, although this is not initially requited. She gives the quest Proof of Love, and her Community is gained alongside Leo's upon its completion.
Scarlet Rocket is a Key Item in . It can be crafted by Hugo at Campsites.
Secret Flag Blueprint is a Key Items in . It can be found in a chest after activating the Mernes Falls Barney Stone during the quest Barmy Tale of Barney.
The Secret Bell Blueprint is a Key Item in . It can be found in a chest after beating the Barney Stone enemies in the Millennium Grotto.

The Secret Pot Blueprint is a Key Item in . It can be found in a chest after beating the Barney Stone enemies in the cave requiring Level 3 "Swift Swordplay" and Level 3 "Focus" Field Skills to access.
The Secret Wing Blueprint is a Key Item in . It can be found in a chest after beating the Barney Stone enemies in Titan's Ulcer.

Scurvy Curtis is a story exclusive enemy in . He is an Urayan Mercenary hired by Gort who is fought at level 17 in Gormott alongside Gort, Insufferable Ulysses, and Antipathetic Archibald. He wields a megalance in battle, but has no Blade. As with all story exclusive enemies in , this enemy drops no items, only gold.

Scapular Lance (Japanese: , Kenyoku no Yari) is a landmark in . It is a large spire of rock located on the Bionis' Shoulder, directly before Gamaro Hollow, and can only be reached by travelling north from Thulles Way, along Fyme Lane. A Hover Stone can be found behind the lance.
Secure the Area (Japanese: , Shūi no Anzenkakuho) is a quest in . It can be received from Mithril on the shore east of Junks on the Bionis' Shoulder.
Sarja is a NPC in . She is a Homs who can be found at Heroes' Rest on the Bionis' Shoulder.
Sapling Amulets are light arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Kino.
Sapling Anklets are light feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Kino.
Sapling Hair Ties are light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Kino.
Sapling Knapsacks are light legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Kino.
Sapling Vests are light torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Kino.

"Sea God Sword Technique: 500 Heavy Waves") is Aegaeon's Level IV Blade Special in and Hugo and Aegaeon's level IV Blade Special in . The version in is unlocked after the party sets off for Auresco. If Sea God's Tidal Wave is activated by Hugo, the special's element will be determined by the Arming Sword he has equipped.

Samon's Secret Storage (Japanese: , Samon no Himitsu Sōko) is a location in , located in the Great Sword Passage at the Great Sword's Base. It is a secret storage room belonging to Samon that becomes accessible after obtaining the Secret Storage Key. There are two Containers found in here.
The Sea Lizards' Tide Pool (Japanese: , Umitokage no Shiodamari) is a Location in . It is located in Erythia Sea.

Samide Anloods (Japanese: , Samuīdo Haindo) are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Anlood family, and can be found at level 31-32 in High Maktha Wildwood.

Scorpox Exoskeletons are items in and . They are commonly dropped by the Scorpox family and can be found as early as the Lun Scorpox. They are needed to craft Steel Protection V.

Samon's Thing is a Key Item in . It is an unknown item Samon has the party bring to Tempapa during Culinary Repertoire.

Saucy-Glossy Gem Lobsters are Meal items in . They can be cooked by Manana at Rest Spots. One Silver Nopon Coin can be used to cook this meal instead of the necessary ingredients. They are unlocked after purchasing the Whole Wild Lobster from the Michiba Canteen for the first time.

Savant Arachnos (Japanese: , Sāvanto Supaido, lit. Servant Arachno) are four Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 26 in the Urayan Tunnels during A Nopon's Counsel.
Sapphire Belts are DLC Accessories in . They can be purchased from Prize X-change Red in the Land of Challenge for 6000 Noponstones.
Searing Fury (Japanese: ) is a Battle Art in . It is an art that can only be used by Cammuravi.

The Sealed Room is a location in . It is located at the bottom of the Ancient Ship and is where Pyra is held in stasis. The doors leading to the passage from the Engine Room can only be opened by a Leftherian. This location can only be accessed by performing the Instant-death Code at the beginning of Chapter 2. There are no enemies here.
Scourwind Necklaces are DLC Accessories in . They can be purchased from Prize X-change Blue in the Land of Challenge for 6000 Noponstones.

The Sealed Cave (Japanese: , Tozasareta Dōkutsu) is a Landmark in , located on the Aurora Shelf. It serves as the entrance into the Declessa Cave Temple Ruins that is becomes accessible via an Ether Slide during Ether Lift Research after Rex uses Double Spinning Edge to clear away the boulders blocking the entrance.
Saomi is an NPC in . She works for the Liberators alongside Hyzen. Her Community is gained when talking to her after completing Snow Man's Treasure and changing Hyzen's Community status.
Salty Aligo Visceras are collectibles in . They are dropped from the Aligo family of enemies. The common variant can also be purchased from the Col. 9 Supply Office (New).
Scenario Quests are a type of Quest in . They are mandatory Quests required for progressing the plot.

Sailing the Seas is a track from , composed by ACE. It is track three of disc six from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track three of disc seventeen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays while riding the Boundary in Erythia Sea.

Sea of Clouds is a track from , composed by ACE. It is track eleven of disc five from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track eleven of disc ten from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the following moments: * Rex and Azurda witnessing a Titan dying and sinking beneath the Cloud Sea. * Mythra talking with Fan la Norne on the Indoline Titan Ship * Mythra and Poppi creating their promise in the Land of Morytha. * Rex's encounter with the phantasm of Azurda in the First Low Orbit Station. * The Architect's explanation of the results of his goal to recreate life in Alrest, as well as for him not taking action when Amalthus took the Logos and Pneuma cores

Salvage Result is a theme from , composed by Kenji Hiramatsu. It is track twelve of disc six from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack Deluxe Edition. It plays when Rex brings up treasure from Salvaging. In , this theme plays when the party opens a Relic and obtains an Art Unlock Kit, Accessory Unlock Kit, Affinity Growth Unlock Kit, Gem Unlock Kit, or Lessons in Unity.

Sara Weeda is a Dutch singer for the Irish choir group [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/An%C3%BAna ANÚNA], which previously worked on songs from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack. She is the vocalist for A Step Away and Where We Belong from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack.
Samly is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti child who can be found at the Waypoint Market in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.

Satoru Iwata (Japanese: , Iwata Satoru; December 6, 1959 - July 11, 2015) was a Japanese game developer and business executive. He began working as a programmer while in college and joined HAL Laboratories after graduating from the Tokyo Institute of Technology. While at HAL Laboratories he worked on many titles, including the Kirby and Pokemon series, Earthbound, and Smash Bros. Satoru Iwata died on July 11, 2015 of bile duct cancer.

Sarah Àlainn is a Japanese vocalist and violinist. She was raised in Sydney, Australia, and discovered her musical talents at the young age of five. She enrolled at the University of Sydney where she obtained her BA Arts Language degree, specializing in linguistics and music. She is the singer of the Ending Theme - Beyond the Sky from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack.

Sayulee is a bilingual vocalist and songwriter. She was raised in Japan and New Zealand and is fluent in both Japanese and English. She is the singer of The way from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack.

Sharla (Japanese: , Karuna, Carna; English dub: ) is one of the seven playable characters in , and a medic of the Colony 6 Defence Force. She uses an ether rifle to fight, and her speciality is healing. She is Juju's older sister and Gadolt's fiance. She becomes playable during Chapter 4.

Shield Bugs (Japanese: , Aozorakamemushi, Bluesky Shield Bug) are collectables in . They can be found in Makna Forest. According to their description, they turned blue after having dreams of dancing in the sky. Three are required for Hunt for Bug-Loving Friend.

Sesame (Japanese: , Sorutosesami) is a Homs in . He can be found southeast of the Gem Man's Stall in the northeastern portion of the Commercial District of Colony 9. During The Plan - Execution, it is revealed that he has put together a fireworks display for the residents of Colony 9 to uplift their spirits.

Shiny Kromar Hide (Japanese: , Supikaru-zoku no Kitae Kawa) are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by some Kromars in the Eryth Sea. One location where Kromars can be found patrolling around is on Hovering Reef 8. They can also be traded for by Arielle found in Alcamoth. According to their description, they are pelts so polished that they could fall apart at any second. Three are required for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In Definitive Edition, they can be purchased in Time Attack place from Nopon Archsage for 2,100 Noponstones.

Sharp Hox Spur (Japanese: , Hoggusu no Ippon Hari) are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Easy Hox in the Bionis' Leg, north of Gaur Plain on the ledge overlooking the small lake. They can also be traded for with Matryona after she leaves Refugee Camp and moves to Colony 6. According to their description, they are the first-growth spurs that are more penetrating than other spurs. Two are required for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In Definitive Edition, they can be purchased in Time Attack place from Nopon Archsage for 800 Noponstones.

The Shining Pond (Japanese: , Kagayaku Numa) is a Secret Area in . It is located in Satorl Marsh, west of the Dark Swamp. The path starts in the Dark Swamp area, between the west edge of the poison bog and the ether deposit. Damage is inevitable when crossing the pond, but is less serious than the damage taken when walking in the Poison Swamp area. One of Cheryl's son's items needed to complete Mementos of a Lost Son can be found here. The pond itself is also important for A Mysterious Delicacy.

Shin Newts (Japanese: , Suneimori) are collectables in . They can be found in Tephra Cave. According to their description, they are black newts that love to be by clean water. Four are required for Reversed Tastes.

Shilx (Japanese: , Shītakurosu) is a Machina in . He can be found near the shops in the Hidden Machina Village on the Fallen Arm. If he is invited to Colony 6, he can be found upstairs near the entrance.

Shin Geckos (Japanese: , Suneyamori) are collectables in . They can be found in Tephra Cave. According to their description, their suckered feet allow them to go anywhere and they have lovely blue bodies. Two are needed for Dean's Shady Request.

Shiny Scarabs (Japanese: , Shiyakawakabuto) are collectables in . They can be found in Mechonis Field and Colony 6. According to their description, they are cute shiny beetles that are not the type to pick a fight with others.
Serpent Gear (Japanese: , Sāpento Gia) is medium head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Shell Armour is medium torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Serpent Armour is medium torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be dropped by the Elder Gragus.
Shell Leggings are medium legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained as various quest rewards. They are made with hard shells from Eryth Sea.
Shell Gauntlets are medium arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are made from hard shells from Eryth Sea.
Serpent Gauntlets are medium arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are said to be made from snakeskin.
Serpent Leggings are medium legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by the Elder Gragus.
Shaker Edge (Japanese: , Sheikā Ejji) is one of Shulk's physical arts in and . It inflicts Daze on a Toppled enemy.

Shadow Eye (Japanese: , Shadō Ai) is one of Shulk's supporting arts in and , and is learned at level 10. It reduces Shulk's current total aggro, but has no effect on aggro gain after its use. It also gives him a Physical Arts Plus buff, increasing the damage of his physical arts by 50% for five seconds. The amount of aggro reduced depends on the art's level.
Shell Boots are medium feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained as quest rewards after completing various quests. They are made from hard shells from Eryth Sea.
A Shield Ramtok (Japanese: , Gōjun Ramutoku, Hard Shield Ramtok) is a weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a gunlance wielded by Reyn.
The Shift Rifle (Japanese: , Shifutoraifuru) is an Ether Rifle in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is Sharla's original weapon, and can only otherwise be obtained through trading.

Serpent Biters (Japanese: , Jakotsu no Kamukamu) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are biters that can be wielded by Riki. They can be acquired by purchasing them at Colony 6 Shop 4 for 11,000 G. They can also be acquired by trading with Lunara who can be found in Alcamoth as well as the Nopon Sage who can be found in Makna Forest.
Shilpala Gloves are medium arms armour in . They are unique, and they come with a Paralysis Resist IV gem equipped.
Serpent Boots are medium feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Shade Glasses (Japanese: , Shēdo Gurasu) are light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are not part of an armour set. They are not available for trade, but can be acquired by defeating enemies in Tephra Cave, Colony 6, and Mechonis Field.

Showdown Cliff (Japanese: , Tekitaisha no Ganpeki) is a location in . It is a cliff on the edge of Eryth Sea, just north of Hovering Reef 1. It has a small wind Ether Crystal Deposit, several Hilns and a group of six Hodes (four Unines and two Archers) facing a group of three Pulse Orlugas. It is also the location of the Abominable Hiln, which needs to be defeated for Mislabelling Problem.

The Seven Sage Cloister (Japanese: , 7 Kenja no Mitsugi-sho) is a Secret Area in . It is an observation platform on the top floor of the Central Tower which offers an aerial view of Agniratha and an unobstructed view of the Meyneth Shrine. The Cloister can be reached through either of two observation doors at the Data Centre. To unlock these doors, the party must complete all the quests in Agniratha and obtain the Cloister Key from the Capital Control Terminal. There is an Ether Gear on the south pathway to the Cloister which produces Bleed Plus IV and Quick Step IV ether crystals.

Shield Bullet (Japanese: , Shīrudo Baretto) is one of Sharla's Ether arts in . It gives a Damage Immunity buff to one party member. The buff lasts for a certain amount of time or until it has absorbed a certain amount of damage, whichever comes first. In , Kino has an identical version of this art called Shield Kaclang.

Shadeless Matrix (Japanese: , Usukage no Matorikusu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Vang family, and can be found during the night in the tunnel north from Cliff Lake, which is in Colony 9. It is level 44 and non-aggressive. It can drop Vang Hair Clips, which are needed for Betty's Gift.

Shalen (Japanese: , Sheren) is a High Entia in Xenoblade Chronicles. She is the manager of the Syrath Lighthouse, and can be found on the lighthouse in Eryth Sea. She has feelings for her co-worker Jarack.
Shield Bash (Japanese: , Shīrudobasshu) is one of Reyn's physical arts in . If used on a Toppled enemy, it will be Dazed. In , Nene has an identical version of this art called Shield Kersmash.

Sentimental Flamral (Japanese: , Jōnen no Furamuraru) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a Mechon, and can be found at level 66 in the Judicial District of Agniratha. Two M67/RADARs standing in front of it, or two Defensive/SHAMEs patrolling nearby, may join the battle.
Serene Heart (Japanese: , Meikyōshisui) is one of Dunban's arts in . It activates an aura that increases his hit rate and evasion by 50% when active; by 75% when his HP is 15% or less.

Seluas (Japanese: , Serura, Cellular) are gelatinous enemies in . There are four different shapes of Seluas - each with one normal minor enemy kind and one Unique Monster - and they can be found exclusively in the Bionis' Interior. Their name is presumably derived from cell'.
Shadow Stitch (Japanese: , Shadōsutetchi) is one of Melia's Ether arts in and . It may Bind enemies surrounding Melia.

Shops are places in and where items can be bought and sold. They sell a variety of Armour, Weapons, and intermediate Art Manuals. All slotted armour sold in shops has one slot. The sell price listed on armour, weapon, and other item pages is the amount that is received when that item is sold at a shop. The sell price of armour and weapons with empty slots is increased by 20% for each slot; a weapon with three slots is worth 60% more than the same weapon with no slots. Riki's Buy Stuff! skill increases the selling price of all items by 20%. This bonus is received even if he is not in the active party. For example, if a weapon has a sell price of 160 G, Riki's Buy Stuff! skill will raise it to
Shield Ignas (Japanese: , Shīrudo Igūna) are enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 27 in the Exile Fortress in Satorl Marsh.

The Sentinel Mechon (Japanese: , Bōheki-gata Kishinhei) is a story exclusive and quest exclusive enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a Mechon enemy, and can be found at level 53 in Galahad Fortress in the 2nd Fuel Supply Room. It only appears during the quest Lift Battle. It drops the Fortress Pass Key required to complete Lift Battle and move deeper into Galahad Fortress.

The Sero Telethia (Japanese: , Sēro Tereshia) is a story exclusive enemy in . It is a Licorne-type member of the Telethia family, and can be found at level 69 in Colony 6 at Main Entrance during a story event. It is fought along with two Inja Telethia during the first round of the related battle.

The Shiny Ball is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. Finding it is the objective of Search Quest 3 in Frontier Village. It can be found in the Top Housing Level on the sixth floor of Frontier Village.

The Sentient Genesis (Japanese: , Sōzō no Ishiki, Consciousness of Creation) is a landmark in . It is the final area in Memory Space, and is where the final battle with Zanza takes place. At the start of the battle with Zanza, the background is a dark orange and red fiery vortex. However, whenever Zanza uses the Art "World Reconstruct" in either his second or third form, the background will change to either a rotating golden cylinder or a bright blue sky.

Shield Drones II (Japanese: , Shīrudo Furappu 2) is one of Fiora's Talent Arts in . Drones become a barrier, removing all debuffs from Fiora and granting her Debuff Immunity for 30 seconds. This talent art is available when Fiora has Ardi Drones equipped. es:Barrera de Drones II

Shilx's Deliveries are two Key Items in . They are received from Shilx during Delivering the Undeliverable. The first is received when accepting the quest and must be delivered to Gorman, and the second is received during the third quest objective and must be delivered to Berryjammy.

Shrine Transport (Japanese: , Shinden e no Tensō Sōchi) is a Story Quest in . It is received automatically at the entrance of the Central Tower after the story event while progressing through Agniratha. As the first objective, the story quest Pillar Verification Devices is automatically triggered as well.
Serrated Insect Legs are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Red and Yellow Antols, or traded for.
Sharp Antol Jaws are rare materials in . They can be dropped by Ridge Antols or be traded for with Moritz.

Shed Lizard Claws are rare materials in . They can only be dropped by Colony Lizards in the Ether Mine or traded for with Emmy Leater during A Young Captain's Trust and Hoko if he migrates to Colony 6. According to their description, they shed and evolve every four hours and they always have clean new cells.

Shield Drones I (Japanese: , Shīrudo Furappu 1) is one of Fiora's Talent Arts in . Drones become a barrier, granting Fiora a shield effect similar to Shulk's Monado Shield. It blocks the next talent art attack by an enemy, and wears off after 30 seconds. This talent art is available when Fiora has the Ishtar Drones, Mitra Drones, Quadrille Drones, Ishtar Drones L, or Mitra Drones L equipped. es:Barrera de Drones I

Setting Forth (Japanese: , Susume! Nopon Kyōdai, Set Forth! Nopon Brothers) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Muimui on the south side of the BLADE Tower in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.

The Shadow Rise (Japanese: , Kageri no Oka) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, west of New Los Angeles and east of the Starfall Basin landmark. It is where Elma shows Cross the vast wilderness of Primordia during the prologue. The only enemies here are blattas, all of which appear at night.
The Shadow Beach BC (Japanese: , Kageri no Hamabe BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, and is between New Los Angeles to the east and Starfall Basin to the west.

Shield Trooper (known as Shield Battler in the Japanese version) is a Class featured in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is one of two classes that can be leveled up from Striker and can be leveled up to Bastion Warrior. Being a Shield Trooper greatly improves HP and melee attack. The basic equipped weapons are Gatling Guns and Shields. The playable characters of this class include Lin, whereas each H.B.'s and L's class is an Alternative Shield Trooper. Shield Trooper has three Skill slots.

Shields are melee weapons in . They are used by Shield Trooper and Bastion Warrior Classes. Once the Bastion Warrior class has been fully mastered, the weapons can be used regardless of class. Shields are also the melee weapons used by Lin, L, and H.B.

displayed on the Wii U Gamepad]] The Segment Map is a tool in associated with the FrontierNav system. In order to efficiently collect information about Mira, the FrontierNav divides each Region of the world map in multiple hexagonal blocks, called Segments. These Segments are displayed on the Segment Map viewed on the Wii U GamePad. In , the Segment Map can be viewed on the menu screen.
Shield Wall is a Support Battle Art in . It grants the buff Barrier to the user and allies.
Shadowstrike is one of Elma's two Signature Arts in , as well as one of her initial arts. It is a Melee Art. Cross learns this art after completing We Were Soldiers.

Shulk and Fiora (シュルクとフィオルン) is an Event Track in , composed by Yoko Shimomura and arranged by ACE+. It is track 4 of disc 2 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is a heartwarming theme that is heard in the cutscene where the titular Shulk and Fiora take a rest together in Ulna Passage shortly after reuniting on the Fallen Arm, then later when Melia visits Fiora outside Colony 6 after Shulk's seemingly mortal wound in the Mechonis Core. In , this song plays during the following moments: * When Melia recalls her father's and brother's last words to her. * When Melia and Tyrea talk to each other outside Teelan's Laboratory. * During the Quiet Moment A Life Without Visions. * Afte

Shadows Creeping (忍び寄る影, Creeping Shadows) is an Event Track in and , composed and arranged by Manami Kiyota. It is track 7 of disc 2 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is a dark, ominous theme that is heard in the following cutscenes: * Shulk's vision of Juju being attack by Mechon when the party reaches Raguel Bridge * Alvis investigates the Inquisitors' attack on the party in Whitewing Palace * Alvis leads the party to the High Entia Tomb and discusses the Monado with Shulk * Tyrea ambushes Melia in the Ceremony Hall inside the tomb * Alvis and Lorithia discuss the green fluid in the new Mechon weapons * Jade Face spies on the party as they cross the Patella Exhaust at Mec
Seventh Edge is one of Murderess's two Signature Arts in . It is acquired after completing the Affinity Mission The Little Rich Girl.

The Shark's Jaws (Japanese: , Same no Kuchi) are an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, northeast of Bloodpond Basin. The party goes here during Manhunt to fight several Ganglion and rescue Celica and Rock.

Shatskikh, the Flash (Japanese: , Senkō no Shatsukifu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Xiphias, and can be found at level 25 near Northpointe Cove in Primordia. It must be defeated to complete the mission Proficiency Exam 3, which is required in order to receive a Skell License.

Shadow Falsaxums (Japanese: , Jeido Garukasu, Jade Falsaxum) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Falsaxum family, and can be found at level 32-36 on West Ciel Sandsea and the Shivering Sands in Sylvalum. Often they cannot be immediately targeted as they are half-submerged in the ground, and are easily mistaken for crystal structures.

Servant Caro (Japanese: , Sābento Nokkusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Caro family and can be found at level 41 or at level 49 in Sylvalum's Badr Stronghold or Den of the Dead.

The Shallows Grex (Japanese: , Sharō Rupusu) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Grex family and is fought at level 20 at Cliffside Beach during the mission Nine Lives.
Shingo (English dub: ) is an NPC in . He can be found at North Founders Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.
Seidr (Japanese: , Basugia) are a type of Ganglion Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are found in Sylvalum and Cauldros.
Shoal Balaenas (Japanese: , Fōdo Baraena) are enemies in . They are members of the Balaena family. Two can be found at level 41-50 in Primordia Primordia Waters, following Draken, the Drifting Cloud.
Selenic Cetos (Japanese: , Diāna Burikio) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Ceto family. They can be found at level 51-60 at Qing Long Glade in Noctilum during the night.
